intro.title: Kovax playground
intro.heroLead: Try components with Preview / Code, or read the same Markdown from the repo — responsive layout and sticky navigation.
intro.cardDemosBody: Sidebar categories mirror real usage: layout, forms, overlays, tabs, accordion, alerts, progress, pagination, date picker, tables, and more.
intro.cardDocsBody: The Documentation tab renders bundled docs/**/*.md — props tables and prose stay in sync with the repo.
intro.cardLiveBody: The playground aliases kovax-react to library source — edits to components reflect here instantly.
intro.import: Components import from src/ via the kovax-react alias — library changes show up here immediately.
intro.docs: Full copy from docs/ (props tables, guides) lives under Documentation in the header. Live component demos: Components, then pick a sidebar item — e.g. Menu for anchored menus, Overlays for Tooltip, Popover, Modal, Toast, and Dialog, Tabs for the tablist primitives, Accordion for Collapsible / Accordion, Alert for inline banners, Progress for linear and circular bars, or Date picker for react-day-picker wrappers (Preview / Code tabs). The same material appears under Documentation as Markdown (Overlays, Menu, Tabs, Accordion, Alert, Progress, Date picker).
intro.tabs: Each example has Preview and Code tabs.
intro.runBody: From the repo root: npm install, then npm run dev:playground (production build: npm run build:playground). Extra Vite flags: npm run dev -w kovax-playground -- --host.

theme.intro: ThemeProvider ships the kovax-react design tokens as CSS variables, manages light/dark modes, and lets you brand the whole tree (or a single subtree) without forking components.
theme.quickStartLead: Wrap your app once. Every component that uses themeToken() (which is all of them) now reads its values from a single source of truth.
theme.quickStartPreview: Once the provider is mounted, switching colorMode instantly re-themes every descendant — no re-render of business code needed.
theme.colorModeLead: useColorMode() returns the active mode plus stable setters. Use it for theme toggles, persisted preferences, or coordinating third-party widgets.
theme.colorModeDemoDescription: colorMode reflects the user's choice; resolvedColorMode is always "light" or "dark" (system → resolved through prefers-color-scheme).
theme.scopedLead: Pass a ref to target. The provider writes data-kovax-theme on that element only, so you can render a dark widget in an otherwise light page (or vice versa).
theme.scopedLightBody: Locked to the light palette regardless of the global mode.
theme.scopedDarkBody: Locked to the dark palette — perfect for product hero blocks or media surfaces.
theme.brandLead: Provide partial overrides via the palettes prop. Anything you don't set falls back to the built-in light/dark palette.
theme.brandDemoDescription: Tap the button to swap primary for a custom purple ramp inside this card only.
theme.useThemeLead: useTheme() exposes the full context — useful for design tooling, palette previews, or driving third-party libraries with the right colors.
theme.useThemeDescription: These swatches are read live from useTheme().palette. They change whenever the active color mode flips.
theme.tokensTitle: Reading tokens from your own components
theme.tokensLead: themeToken("…") returns a var(--kx-…, fallback) string. It works inside CSS-in-JS, plain style props, and even server-rendered HTML — the fallback keeps things looking correct before hydration.
theme.tokensPreview: This card composes themeToken calls for background, color, padding, shadow and transition. Flip the global mode in the header to watch it animate.
theme.ssrLead: ThemeProvider is SSR-safe. Render it on the server with a known defaultColorMode (or read a cookie) to avoid a hydration flash. Use storageKey={false} on isolated trees you don't want persisted.
theme.ssrPreview: On the server we render with defaultColorMode="light" (or whatever you store in a cookie) so the first paint matches the user's last choice — no flash, no layout shift.
theme.propColorMode: Controlled mode. When provided, the provider ignores internal state and storage — drive it from your own store.
theme.propOnChange: Fires after every effective mode change (including system resolution flips). Use it to sync analytics, cookies, or remote prefs.
theme.propStorageKey: localStorage key for persistence. Pass false or null to disable (e.g. inside scoped providers).
theme.propPalettes: Partial overrides per side. Merged on top of the built-in light/dark palettes (color ramps, base colors, shadows).
theme.propTarget: Element that receives the data-kovax-theme attribute. Defaults to documentElement; pass a ref to scope theming to a subtree.
theme.propNonce: nonce attribute forwarded to the injected <style>. Required when running under a strict Content-Security-Policy.

avatar.intro: Avatar shows a profile photo or generates initials / custom fallback content in a fixed circular or softly rounded frame. Deep import: kovax-react/avatar.
avatar.photoLead: Pass src and alt. While the image loads successfully, initials are hidden.
avatar.a11yNote: Accessibility: without src, set name (preferred) or aria-label so the fallback keeps an accessible name. With src, provide meaningful alt unless the avatar is purely decorative.

badge.intro: Badge is a compact pill for statuses, counts, and meta labels. Surfaces follow semantic palettes (solid, outline, subtle). Deep import: kovax-react/badge.
badge.matrixLead: Each row is a variant; chips show every color. Default is variant="subtle" + color="neutral".
badge.a11yNote: Accessibility: Badge is a <span> — not interactive. For removable filters use Button with appropriate labeling; for live counts pair with visible nearby context or aria-label on a parent.

skeleton.intro: Skeleton reserves layout while content loads: pulse (opacity), shimmer (gradient sweep), or static none. Uses secondary.* surfaces and motion tokens. Deep import: kovax-react/skeleton.
skeleton.variantsLead: Keyframes are injected once on mount when variant is not none. Duration and easing come from themeToken("duration.slow") and themeToken("easing.standard").
skeleton.textLead: With text, height follows text.sm; narrow the last line with style={{ width: "…" }} or width.
skeleton.a11yNote: Accessibility: default role="presentation" and aria-hidden treat Skeleton as decorative — pair real loading semantics (aria-busy, visible labels) on the surrounding region.
skeleton.motionNote: Prefer variant="none" when the user has requested reduced motion.

tokens.intro: Single source of truth for the visual language: palettes, spacing, radii, typography, motion, layering, and breakpoints. Every value below is exported from kovax-react and accessible through themeToken("…").
tokens.colorsLead: Each palette uses the 50 → 900 ladder. Use 50–200 for surfaces, 300–500 for accents, 600–900 for text and focus.
tokens.typographyLead: Type ramp, weights, line-heights, and tracking. Components consume these via the same string tokens.
tokens.spacingLead: Inset and stack rhythm. Bars below show the actual rem width — the bar at 5xl is 96px on the default root.
tokens.radiusLead: Composable radii — pair smaller values for compact UI and larger for cards / marketing surfaces.
tokens.shadowLead: Elevation ladder plus utility shadows: an inner shadow for sunken surfaces and a focus ring for accessibility.
tokens.motionLead: Pair duration and easing tokens for transitions. Legacy transition.* strings remain for back-compat.
tokens.zIndexLead: Predictable stacking for overlays. Higher value renders above lower one.
tokens.breakpointsLead: Em-based viewport breakpoints — they scale with the user's root font size for better accessibility.

layout.intro: One block per primitive from docs/components/Layout/: a props table (from the docs) and a live example. Full prose lives under header Documentation → Layout.
layout.stackHint: HStack / VStack share the same props; VStack defaults to align="stretch".
layout.flexCenterHint: Composition pattern: Flex defines the region; Center centers its child.

typography.intro: Text primitives backed by sizes.text tokens. Full reference — header Documentation → Typography.

button.intro: Buttons (including IconButton, ButtonGroup), polymorphic as, loading and accessibility props. Props tables — header Documentation → Button.

controls.intro: Choice controls with Kovax tokens, sizes, and FormControl context. Reference — header Documentation → Controls.

select.intro: Native Select matches Input surfaces; useCombobox + VirtualizedListbox provide an accessible headless autocomplete layer. Reference — header Documentation → Select.

overlays.intro: Tooltip, anchored Popover / Dropdown, compound Dialog, structured Modal, and imperative Toast (ToastProvider, useToast). Anchored menus live under Components → Menu. Reference — header Documentation → Overlays.

menu.intro: Menu / DropdownMenu — role="menu" on top of Popover: keyboard (↑/↓, Home/End), optional enter animation (motion), kovax-react/menu. Full markdown: header Documentation → Menu.
menu.docsCrossLink: Docs: props and advanced Popover wiring — docs/components/Menu.md under Documentation → Menu.

input.intro: Text fields and multi-line Textarea: sizes, color schemes, masks (Input), validation, and native HTML attributes. Reference — header Documentation → Input.

form.intro: Label, helper text, and error wiring. FormControl shares invalid/required/disabled via React context with Input, Textarea, Select, Checkbox, Radio, Switch, FormLabel, and FormHelperText (explicit props override). Reference — header Documentation → Form.

tabs.intro: Compound Tabs (Tabs.Root, List, Trigger, Content) with ARIA wiring, keyboard navigation, optional sliding line indicator, and panel fade. Reference — header Documentation → Tabs.

accordion.intro: Collapsible wraps one trigger and one panel; Accordion composes several items with shared keyboard navigation (single / multiple, optional collapsible). Triggers show an animated chevron on the right by default — override with the chevron prop; panel height and chevron share motionDurationMs. Use variant and size on Accordion.Root for chrome and density. Reference — header Documentation → Accordion.
accordion.demoToggleHint: Single-row previews include collapsible (Accordion.Root collapsible). Click the open header again to collapse — that shows the height/chevron animation so you can compare motion speed below.

alert.intro: Alert is an inline banner with token-backed surfaces by tone, optional heading, dismiss control, and polite or assertive live region semantics. Reference — header Documentation → Alert.
alert.triggerHint: Choose a tone above — the banner appears below and updates the live region.

triggerBody.info: You can wire alerts from menus, toasts, or form submit handlers.
triggerBody.warning: This action cannot be undone after you continue.
triggerBody.error: Try again in a moment or contact support.

alert.dismissedHint: Banner dismissed — reload the page or switch section and back to try again.

progress.intro: LinearProgress and CircularProgress expose role="progressbar" with optional indeterminate motion; palette via colorScheme and density via size. Reference — header Documentation → Progress.

datePicker.intro: DatePicker and DateRangePicker wrap react-day-picker v9 with Kovax Button, Popover, and palette CSS variables. Use variant="date" (default) or variant="datetime" for time fields + Apply. Requires peer react-day-picker and global react-day-picker/style.css. Reference — header Documentation → Date picker.
datePicker.rhfNote: react-hook-form is only a playground dependency — use Controller so value/onChange stay aligned.

table.intro: Table primitives (Table.Root, Table, caption, regions, cells) use Kovax spacing and neutrals; DataTable maps columns + rows with optional sort buttons and aria-sort. Reference — header Documentation → Table.
table.dataHint: Sorting is controlled: handle onSortChange and pass sorted rows as data.

pagination.intro: Pagination exposes a compact nav with prev/next triggers, numbered pages, and ellipsis gaps. Motion follows theme duration/easing tokens and drops transform when prefers-reduced-motion is set.
pagination.siblingsLead: Increase siblingCount to show more numbers around the active page before collapsing with an ellipsis.
